audit.whatIsWrong: Rated 7.5/10 difficulty and labelled 'Tricky' on a 59.58% Emerald+ win rate over 720 games — and the mirror page (audits/top/gwen__singed.json) already rates this HARD 8/10 from Gwen's side. Two 7.5-8/10 'hard' ratings on the same matchup cannot both be true.
audit.why: Ratings are inverse across the mirror; 8/10 for Gwen means roughly 2/10 for Singed.
audit.corrected: diffRating 2/10, with the difficulty breakdown line and the final-rating report row moved to match. Sides were already correct (Singed six rows, Gwen at 6) and agree with both the packet and the mirror, so no chart flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was generic template text about ult-ghost-proxy that never named Gwen's actual spike, and used male pronouns for her.
audit.why: Gwen's only window is 6: Needlework (120s at rank 1) slows and Skip 'n Slash gives attack speed to stick. The counter to it is Insanity Potion applying Grievous Wounds through Poison Trail.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Needlework and Skip 'n Slash as her window and Grievous Wounds as your answer, matching the mirror's Level 6 row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist's cooldown is written as 16 seconds in four places (spikes[1].text, wants.you[0], mid twice, whys[3]). It is 22/21/20/19/18 — the entire 'wait out the mist' plan was timed six seconds short at rank 1. Hallowed Mist is also described as something that 'blocks your Fling'; Riot's text is 'She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist', which is untargetability to enemies OUTSIDE the mist, not a Fling block. And the decisive interaction was absent: Mega Adhesive grounds, and Gwen's own kit file flags Skip 'n Slash as 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny' — a Gwen standing in the glue cannot dash at all. Fling's root is conditional ('If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive'), so the vial has to go down first. Insanity Potion making Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds directly counters A Thousand Cuts, which is her sustain in every extended trade.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon cooldowns and descriptions for both kits.
audit.corrected: Mist corrected to 22s at rank 1 and re-described as untargetability from outside; Mega Adhesive (17s) grounding Skip 'n Slash (13s, partly refunded on hit) written in as the lane's decisive interaction; Fling's root stated as conditional on the goo; Grievous Wounds vs A Thousand Cuts added.

audit.why: Anti-heal is already core in the itemization row and Mercury's Treads are already listed, which is right against a champion whose damage floor is Snip Snip! true damage plus percent-health passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: The on-hit nature of Skip 'n Slash was never mentioned. Riot: it grants 'Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage On-Hit', and 'If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded' — so armour reads her trade wrong and her dash comes back faster than 13s whenever she connects.
audit.why: Riot description plus the _missing 'onhit-itemization' rule for this pairing.
audit.corrected: Skip 'n Slash now described with its on-hit component and its partial cooldown refund on hit.

edits.before: At levels 1 through 3 Gwen is a short-range melee champion with a stubby E dash and no chase. Run Poison Trail directly through her — she has to walk into your cloud to last-hit minions, and she takes tickdown damage every second she stays near you. She will try to Q-snip you for the true damage stacks but her Q range is short and she cannot chase you down. Level 3 opens your W-Fling combo: throw Mega Adhesive behind her line of retreat and flip her into the puddle, and she is rooted inside your poison with no mist up. She cannot leave the W zone without taking the root — this is your punish window every time Hallowed Mist is on cooldown.
edits.after: At levels 1 through 3 Gwen is a short-range melee champion with a stubby E dash and no chase. Run Poison Trail directly through her — she has to walk into your cloud to last-hit minions, and she takes tickdown damage every second she stays near you. She will Snip Snip! for true-damage stacks, but it is 450 range and Mega Adhesive grounds the dash she needs to follow. Level 3 opens your W-Fling combo: throw Mega Adhesive behind her line of retreat and flip her into the puddle, and she is rooted inside your poison with no mist up. She cannot leave the W zone without taking the root — this is your punish window every time Hallowed Mist is on cooldown.

edits.before: At levels 4 through 5 start proxying behind her wave to force gold while she is stuck contesting her own tower. She will pop Hallowed Mist defensively when you approach — let her waste it, then back off for 16 seconds and return to proxy. At level 6 her R gives her three charges of long-range snips, but her win condition is still getting inside the mist and Q-stacking you. Your win condition is the 16-second window between Hallowed Mist casts: the moment the mist drops, run at her, W behind her escape route, and Fling her into the puddle. Insanity Potion's bonus AP, armor, and magic resistance plus movement speed means she cannot outdamage you in the open if you keep running through her.
edits.after: At levels 4 through 5 start proxying behind her wave to force gold while she is stuck contesting her own tower. She will pop Hallowed Mist defensively when you approach — let her waste it, then back off for the full 22 seconds and return to proxy. At level 6 her R gives her three charges of long-range snips, but her win condition is still getting inside the mist and Q-stacking you. Your win condition is the 22-second window between Hallowed Mist casts: the moment the mist drops, run at her, W behind her escape route, and Fling her into the puddle. Insanity Potion also makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which guts the A Thousand Cuts healing her whole extended-trade plan rests on.

notes: The 16-second Hallowed Mist cooldown was wrong in four places and is the single worst error on this page — the real value is 22/21/20/19/18, so every 'wait it out' timing was six seconds optimistic at rank 1. Did not touch phase RATINGS: the mirror set Gwen's rows to 7/7/7/8/5/8/8, which is identical to Singed's rows rather than inverse — that looks like a mirror-side error but flipping only my side would create a fresh contradiction, so it is left for tools/mirror-fix.js. diffRating was inverted to 2/10 to match the mirror's 8/10.
